pages.title: Cosmic String Segment
pages.text: A one-dimensional defect in spacetime left over from a phase transition in the early universe: a line of trapped false vacuum, thinner than a proton but immensely heavy. Space around it is cut and rejoined with a missing wedge, so objects beside it appear doubled. It hums when it moves.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)When a White Hole Fragment emitted through a Hawking Emitter, its outflow cooled too quickly and froze into defects. In the White Hole Emitter I caught one: a filament of the early universe. A bulk monolith also held one, coiled up.
